assumptions_not_material_measurements.kinetics: Irreversible homogeneous sequential first-order H7->H6->H5 at fixed conditions, initially all H7. No reverse reaction, nucleation, spatial transport, interfaces or simultaneous direct H7->H5 channel.
assumptions_not_material_measurements.storage: One effective first-order loss rate and chosen Arrhenius prefactor; independent of synthesis-stage rates.
assumptions_not_material_measurements.entropy: Six equiprobable independent vacancy orientations per H5 formula only; not a full vibrational or configurational free energy.
assumptions_not_material_measurements.W0_sweep: Hypothetical energy sweep in phase_access_gates.py is separate from the actual Dolui numeric-data extraction.
assumptions_not_material_measurements.uncertainty_sweep: Per-atom error budgets are illustrative assumptions, not calibrated CHGNet or DFT uncertainty.
